variables.name: modelSettings.extrathoracicExternalPressure
variables.description: pressure of a suit on the lower body (MAST, anti-G suit)

variables.name: modelSettings.mastCoverage
variables.description: share of the extrathoracic veins and tissues under the suit (legs and abdomen)

variables.name: modelSettings.abdominalPressure
variables.description: intra-abdominal pressure; compresses the inferior vena cava and the abdominal veins

variables.name: modelSettings.abdominalTransmission
variables.description: fraction of the intra-abdominal pressure transmitted into the thorax

variables.name: modelSettings.abdominalVenousFraction
variables.description: share of the extrathoracic veins inside the abdomen (splanchnic veins)

variables.name: modelSettings.targetBloodVolume
variables.description: blood volume the kidneys steer toward; the default is the initial volume

variables.name: modelSettings.renalVolumeControlRate
variables.description: 1/time constant of the kidneys' approach to targetBloodVolume; 0 = kidneys off

variables.name: rightHeart.righHeartCardiacElastance.heartIntervals.HP
